minutes.headline: Personnel Committee sent a Special Town Meeting article adding an intermittent heavy equipment operator and principal assessor to the pay plan.
minutes.summary: The committee approved minutes, reorganized with new members, and elected a chair, vice chair and secretary. It reviewed a job description for a part-time intermittent DPW heavy equipment operator, debating tree-work wording and pay grade. It approved the description at grade nine and voted to submit a Special Town Meeting article adding that position and the principal assessor to the Salary Administration Plan.

votes.outcome: passed (one member voted nay, apparently the nominee's own vote as heard; tally unclear)

votes.motion: Approve the new job description for the intermittent heavy equipment operator at grade nine of the SAP, with the tree-work wording changed.
Submit an article to Special Town Meeting amending the Salary Administration Plan to add intermittent heavy equipment operator at grade nine and principal assessor at grade fifteen.

budget_items.what_was_said: Members worried the grade nine rate might not attract applicants compared with what temp drivers have been paid.

budget_items.topic: Grade nine and ten pay ranges
budget_items.what_was_said: The pay ranges for the two grades were read out, and the position is hourly with no benefits beyond retirement enrollment.

budget_items.topic: Cost of employing plow drivers versus contracting
budget_items.what_was_said: It is cheaper to hire intermittent employees using town vehicles than to contract out the work.
The article would assign the principal assessor position a pay grade.

decisions.decision: The tree-work sentence in the job description will be reworded to cover tree work and storm cleanup, as the director assigns.
A new category for the part-time CDL position will be added to the classification list after the meeting.

what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee voted to submit a Special Town Meeting article adding an intermittent heavy equipment operator and a principal assessor to the Salary Administration Plan.
The committee approved a new job description for the part-time intermittent DPW heavy equipment operator at grade nine, with the tree-work wording changed.
Members questioned whether the grade nine rate would attract applicants, compared with what temporary drivers have been paid.
The tree-work sentence will be reworded to cover tree work and storm cleanup as the director assigns.
The reorganized committee elected a chair, vice chair and secretary; the chair vote was recorded with one nay, tally unclear as heard.

why_it_matters: Pay grades set in the Salary Administration Plan become town payroll costs, mostly taxes, and Town Meeting voters will be asked to approve the added positions and their grades.
The discussion of using intermittent employees with town vehicles instead of contracting out plowing touches how winter road service is staffed and paid for.
watch_next: The Special Town Meeting article amending the Salary Administration Plan, which voters will be asked to act on.
A new classification-list category for the part-time CDL position, to be added after the meeting.
